subject.title: fix(providers): preserve WhatsApp and Zalo delivery

question: May raw recorder JSONL add documented versioned atomic batch records while supported Crabline reader APIs continue flattening them into individual events?
rationale: The implementation preserves Crabline API consumers, but code, tests, and history cannot establish whether direct one-event-per-line raw JSONL consumers are covered by a permanent compatibility promise.

options.title: Accept Versioned Batches
options.body: Treat Crabline reader APIs as the supported contract and permit documented atomic batch lines after real provider proof is supplied.

options.title: Preserve One-Event Lines
options.body: Require a different atomic publication design if raw one-event-per-line JSONL is part of the supported external contract.

options.title: Keep Draft Paused
options.body: Leave the branch in draft while either recorder compatibility intent or provider-native proof remains unresolved.

recommendation.title: Accept Versioned Batches
recommendation.body: Treat Crabline reader APIs as the supported contract and permit documented atomic batch lines after real provider proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history most directly owns the recorder runtime and both provider lifecycles affected by this choice.
